name: dsh-session-manual-title
description: Rename a session with AI on demand: one menu row and one header chip summarize the whole conversation into a title, reusing the main request's prefix cache instead of spending tokens on every message.
author: freedani

summary.en: Adds "Rename with AI" to the session menu and the session header: one click summarizes the whole conversation into a title, reusing the main request's prefix cache. Nothing runs on its own, so it costs nothing until you click.
summary.zh: 在会话「…」菜单和会话标题栏各加一个「AI 重命名」：点一次才让模型通读整个会话起一个标题，并复用主请求的 prefix cache。不点不跑，不会按消息烧 token。
